title: Relative marked-anodyne fibrant replacement
statement: Use marked simplicial sets, Cartesian fibrations and the relative Cartesian model $\mathsf M_S$ of [lem-coef-marked-relative-cartesian-model], and the four marked-anodyne generator types of [lem-coef-marked-anodyne-lifting-calculus]. A marked map over $S$ is marked anodyne if its underlying marked map lies in the weakly saturated class of those generators (closure under pushouts, transfinite composition and retracts). For every small simplicial set $S$, every marked object $X\to S$ admits a functorial marked-anodyne map $X\to Z^\natural$ over $S$, where $Z\to S$ is a Cartesian fibration and $Z^\natural$ marks exactly its Cartesian edges. Every marked-anodyne map over $S$ is a trivial cofibration of $\mathsf M_S$. The replacements and their small-object constructions may be taken in the universe of the input. No quasicategory hypothesis on $S$ is required.
